gloss: limited express ticket; express surcharge ticket

definitions.gloss: limited express ticket; express surcharge ticket
definitions.explanation: A supplementary ticket required in addition to a base fare ticket to ride a limited express (特急) train in Japan. Composed of 特急 (limited express) + 券 (ticket). Without this ticket, passengers cannot ride reserved or non-reserved cars on limited express services.

examples.japanese: {特急券|とっきゅうけん}を{買|か}い{忘|わす}れた。
examples.english: I forgot to buy the express ticket.

examples.japanese: {乗車券|じょうしゃけん}と{特急券|とっきゅうけん}を{合|あ}わせて{五千円|ごせんえん}だった。
examples.english: The base ticket and the express ticket together came to 5,000 yen.

examples.japanese: {新幹線|しんかんせん}に{乗|の}るには、{乗車券|じょうしゃけん}の{他|ほか}に{特急券|とっきゅうけん}が{必要|ひつよう}です。
examples.english: To ride the bullet train, you need an express ticket in addition to a base fare ticket.

notes:
USAGE:
In Japan's railway system, faster train services require a {特急券|とっきゅうけん} on top of the regular {乗車券|じょうしゃけん} (base fare ticket). This includes the {新幹線|しんかんせん} (bullet train) and other limited express services run by JR and private railways.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {特急券|とっきゅうけん}を{買|か}う (buy an express ticket)
- {指定席|していせき}{特急券|とっきゅうけん} (reserved-seat express ticket)
- {自由席|じゆうせき}{特急券|とっきゅうけん} (non-reserved express ticket)

RELATED TERMS:
- {乗車券|じょうしゃけん} (base fare ticket)
- {指定席券|していせきけん} (reserved seat ticket)
- {回数券|かいすうけん} (multi-ride ticket)
- {定期券|ていきけん} (commuter pass)
